newsitem.title: UK: Thomas the Tank Engine talks on track - paper.
newsitem.headline: Thomas the Tank Engine talks on track - paper.

text.p: Britt Allcroft Plc, which took Thomas the Tank Engine to the stock market last year, is negotiating with Anglo-Dutch publishing group Reed-Elsevier to buy the rights to the popular children's character, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.

About 90 percent of Britt Allcroft's business revolves around Thomas television programmes, videos and merchandise. Its rights to use the character are purchased from a master licence held by Reed Childrens Book, under a long- term agreement.
The company is now seeking to buy this master licence, including book publishing rights from Reed, according to the newspaper.
In November, Britt Allcroft raised around 4.2 million pounds ($7.09 million) after floating its shares on the London Stock Exchange. ($1=.5921 Pound)
